intro: Certified, registered and compliant — with copies of every certificate available on request. For procurement teams running supplier onboarding, this page contains what your vendor-registration form usually asks for.

items.name: ISO 9001:2015
items.summary: Quality Management System certified across production and inspection.
items.detail: Our ISO 9001:2015 certification covers the press shop, laser cutting, machining, welding and tool room operations, together with incoming, in-process and final inspection. It is the framework behind our 100% inspection commitment — documented procedures, traceable records and defined corrective action.
items.scope: Manufacture of sheet-metal, tubular and deep-draw components, tools and dies

items.name: MSME · Udyam
items.summary: Registered micro & small enterprise under the Government of India Udyam scheme.
items.detail: Udyam registration confirms our status as a registered micro & small enterprise. For buyers, this can carry procurement advantages under Indian public and corporate MSME sourcing policies, including preferential payment terms under the MSMED Act.

items.name: GST Registered
items.summary: Fully tax-compliant and ready for domestic B2B invoicing.
items.detail: We are GST registered and issue compliant tax invoices with e-way billing for domestic B2B supply, so your accounts-payable and input-credit processes are straightforward from the first order.

workingToward.title: Working toward export readiness
workingToward.text: We are building the quality systems, documentation standards and export packaging practices that international OEM and Tier-1 programmes require. We would rather state that plainly than claim certifications we do not yet hold. If you have a specific standard your supply base must meet — IATF 16949, a customer-specific quality manual, or a particular PPAP level — tell us at enquiry stage and we will tell you honestly where we stand against it.

note: Copies of all certificates and registrations are available on request. Ask for them with your first RFQ and we will send them with the quotation.
